dialogue.text: Before we turn to the list, how would you prefer routine account updates to be presented? We can keep the correspondence concise rather than adding lengthy covering notes.

dialogue.text: Short notes better lah. Put anything needing my attention near the top, then leave the background below. Running wholesale, got customers chasing stock and suppliers changing arrangements all day. By the time I sit down, another long email quite tiring.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that presentation preference for routine correspondence. Clear headings should help you distinguish account administration from general information without having to work through a long introduction.

I routed it through my relative's personal account so the business origin wouldn't show. Anyway, keep the covering notes short can already. If something needs a proper conversation, better to speak when I'm at my desk rather than catching me on the warehouse floor.
